messages.wizard.pv_note: Add one PV plane per roof orientation. North 0°, east 90°, south 180°, west 270°; tilt is measured from horizontal. Without PV, keep the empty setting and add no plane.
messages.wizard.name: Name
messages.wizard.device_note: Identifiers match Energiezentrale measurements and control commands. Known capacities and power limits come from the HA configuration and are changed there. messages.wizard.prices_note: These values apply to EOS planning. Accounting remains configured separately under Costs. Annual consumption includes heat pumps but excludes separately optimized vehicle charging.
messages.wizard.planning_note: EOS generates GENETIC plans automatically. Forecast hours must cover the plan and any configured tail horizon. EOS device adapters are disabled: Energiezentrale supplies measurements and controls devices. Enable device control separately after successful verification.
messages.wizard.review_note: These changes will be applied and saved persistently in EOS. Unlisted settings and credentials are retained. If configuration changes in the meantime, generate a new preview.

messages.wizard.success_note: EOS confirmed the values and persistent storage. Measurements are sent again; forecasts and a new plan may take a few minutes. Energiezentrale stays in read-only mode until you enable control. Plans predating this configuration change are rejected.

messages.settings.battery_pv_info: Off by default. Starts after the configured surplus persists throughout the start delay, with a two-percentage-point SoC buffer. Defaults: 150 W and 60 s. PV fluctuations are bridged while charging. Stops after a continuous 60 s PV deficit of at least the threshold against all other loads excluding this car; recovery resets the stop timer. Reaching the higher battery floor stops assistance immediately. Measurement and device faults or insufficient battery power remain safety stops. Requires PV charging and battery support.

messages.billing.settings_note: Changes to the PV cost basis and manual battery parameters apply to future intervals only. Grid tariffs and standing charges apply from the date of each entry, including retroactively. Initial price applies only at first initialization. Without an override, unknown initial stock is valued once at the PV cost basis including charging losses; unknown remaining stock is also valued on upgrade. Manual efficiency/capacity values apply only in manual mode. The PV cost basis defaults to the EOS feed-in tariff. Negative costs are supported.

messages.billing.grid_price_note: The electricity tariff applies from the same date as the base fee. Retrospective fixed-price changes also revalue remaining and already discharged grid battery shares by their charging dates, including battery losses. Charging shares derived from older hourly records are marked as estimates. An unknown charging date is not assigned a later tariff; an entry with no start also covers these shares. Configure the tariff for EOS planning separately in EOS.
messages.billing.base_price_note: Sum of all fixed charges (supplier, grid, metering). Each entry applies from its date until the next change, including retrospective entries. An empty start applies before all dated entries; no applicable entry means no base fee. Monthly amounts are spread per calendar day using × 12 / 365; daily amounts apply directly. Only the overall and grid & feed-in balances include the fee.
